one_liner: Podio has a broad REST API with OAuth2 and app-token auth, webhooks, and self-serve API keys on free accounts; the vendor hosts an official MCP server at mcp.podio.com.
auth_notes: OAuth server-side flow is recommended; app authentication uses a special app token (static secret). Client ID/secret are generated from account settings (podio.com/settings/api).
access_notes: Free and paid accounts have full API access; API keys are self-generated from account settings. Rate limits apply; higher limits via add-on or request.
blocker_notes: Modest base rate limits, but they don't block a toolkit.

evidence.quote: then [grab an API key](https://developers.podio.com/api-key) for each app you want to build from your account settings page.
The Podio API is a complete programmable interface to all Podio functionality.
you have the ability to register [webhooks](https://developers.podio.com/examples/webhooks) in your Podio apps
Log in to Podio and go to **Account Settings -> API Keys**
